$comment: react-native-nitro-modules runtime versions this package supports. Code generated by nitrogen >= 0.35 only compiles against runtime >= 0.35, and nitrogen 0.34 output only against 0.32 - 0.34, so both trees ship: nitrogen/generated (modern) and nitrogen/generated-legacy. Read by android/build.gradle, the podspec and scripts/nitro-compat-matrix.sh.
